per_probe: SpawnMeshesToWorld(DataPath, mats, i, j) filters assets whose name ends with `_Tile_i_j` or contains `_Tile_i_j_`; Res = spawned count > 0
on_hit: TileName = Map.Name + `_Tile_i_j`; SaveWorld(AssetData, PackageName, Map.Path, TileName); MapPathsIds.Add(Map.Path/TileName, (i,j,0)); destroy spawned actors
termination_inner: while (Res): first empty (i,j) ends the row
termination_outer: while (i > 0): row ending immediately (i==0, first probe empty) ends everything
package_path_construction: Map.Path + '/' + TileName; SaveWorld renames world + SavePackage to DestPath/WorldName
asset_lookup: object-library scan of DataPath (Maps/<Map> + Static/<Category>/<Map> trees), name-pattern match only
saveworld_call: SaveWorld(AssetData, PackageName, Map.Path, TileName) for hits; SaveWorld(..., Map.Name, false) for the base map after LargeMapManager.GenerateMap(MapPathsIds)
tilesinfo_role: PositionTile0/TileSize feed ONLY LargeMapManager offsets (SetTile0Offset/SetTileSize); defaults (0,0,0)/200000cm without file. Does NOT drive iteration bounds.
dense_rectangle_assumption: PROVEN baked in: contiguous probing from (0,0), row ends at first gap, scan ends at first empty row
